blocks.text: Nearly 30% of PhilHealth-accredited physicians are listed in Metro Manila, which accounts for only 12.2% of the country’s population, according to preliminary research by Ateneo-led authors. MANILA, Philippines — In May 2025, the Philippine Health Insurance Corp. (PhilHealth) listed 49,649 accredited physicians nationwide, or roughly one for every 2,300 people. Nearly three in 10 of these physicians were registered in the National Capital Region (NCR), however, even though the capital accounted for only 12.2% of the country’s population, a preliminary study found. The national ratio was 43.6 accredited physicians for every 100,000 people, less than a third of the 143-per-100,000 benchmark […]...
